Subject: Renewal conversation — throughput uplift + SLA needs

Connor,

Hope you had a good weekend. Horton Labs is coming up on our annual contract renewal and traffic has spiked significantly over the last 6 months. We're looking at two asks for the upcoming 12-month term: 

- Reserve ~2x our current committed throughput (95th pct token throughput) to avoid throttling during peak release windows.
- Move to your Premium SLA package with explicit latency SLOs (95th < 200ms for generation endpoints) and 24/7 priority ops.

High level: we can commit to a 12-month reserved contract if pricing is reasonable, and we'd like to make the switchover aligned with our November product launch. Can you share a pricing delta for the above, whether a dedicated pool is required, and an outline of migration/onboarding work?

I've attached the most recent 90‑day usage export in case that's helpful. Happy to jump on a 30‑minute call this week if that's easier.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Head of ML Platform
Brightline AI

Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — throughput uplift + SLA needs

Thanks Elena — this is exactly the kind of conversation we planned for renewal. Quick notes up front, and then a proposed path below.

Summary answer: yes, we can support a 2x committed uplift and provide a Premium SLA with the latency SLO you called out. There are a couple ways to structure it depending on how quickly you need capacity and whether you prefer a phased approach to limit cost.

Proposed two-step pathway (recommended):
1) Short-term burst reserve (90 days): we allocate a reserved burst pool at a blended rate so you can land your November launch without migration work. This covers immediate peak demand.
2) Dedicated reserved capacity (12-month term): after the burst period, migrate to a dedicated pool with the Premium SLA and formal SLOs in an addendum. Migration work usually takes 2–3 weeks for model pinning + routing policies.

Next steps I'd suggest:
- I attach a draft SLA addendum (proposed-sla-addendum-draft.pdf) and a simple forecasting template (forecasting-template.xlsx) for your team to fill in the expected peak windows.
- Proposed call: Thu 23 Sep or Mon 27 Sep 30 min to walk pricing & timeline.

A few clarifying questions for your team to help price precisely:
- Do you expect sustained 2x for the whole contract or large but intermittent spikes?
- Will you require regional isolation (EU/APAC) or is US region ok?

CC'ing Marissa (sales) and Ben (CS ops) to include pricing and onboarding scope.

Best,
Connor O'Brien

Connor — thanks for the quick reply and the doc. A few clarifications inline below: 

> Do you expect sustained 2x for the whole contract or large but intermittent spikes?

Mostly intermittent spikes tied to feature launches and batch scoring windows. We do, however, want the assurance that bursts won't be throttled. If the short-term burst reserve is much cheaper than moving to dedicated immediately, that's attractive.

> Will you require regional isolation (EU/APAC) or is US region ok?

US region is fine for the first phase. If this goes well, we may later request EU isolation for regulatory customers.

Pricing: what's the ballpark delta vs our current commit? Also, what does the migration look like for model pinning — do you handle that completely on your side?

We can do Thu 23 Sep at 11:00 PT. Please send an invite.

Elena
